tax.text: Smith said keeping taxes low would remain a priority for him.
tax.quote: My priority will always be keeping taxes low for these hardworking folks.

trade.text: Smith supported an America First trade agenda that uses tariffs to seek fair treatment for U.S. producers.
trade.quote: I look forward to working with President Trump to implement an America First trade agenda.

debt.text: Smith said the Ways and Means Committee would protect and preserve Social Security and Medicare benefits.
debt.quote: the Republican-led Ways and Means Committee will protect and preserve seniors’ Social Security and Medicare benefits.

schools.text: Smith authored legislation to let families use 529 savings for K–12 education expenses and choose where children attend school.
schools.quote: I thank Senator Cruz for his partnership on this important issue to expand school choice and uphold individual liberty.

safety.text: Smith backed a commitment to increase funding for police officers.
safety.quote: we will actually INCREASE funding for our police officers who put their lives on the line every day and for our country.

immigration.text: Smith endorsed a mass deportation operation and said he would advance legislation to secure the border.
immigration.quote: Trump’s plan to launch a mass deportation operation is exactly what we need to make our communities safer.

guns.text: Smith said he voted against bills that would expand background check requirements and delay firearm purchases.
guns.quote: I was proud to stand up to support Americans’ constitutional rights by voting against H.R. 8 and H.R. 1446, bills that would delay legal firearm purchases and take the first steps to creating a national gun registry.

abortion.text: Smith said he believes life begins at conception and supported legislation restricting abortion after 20 weeks.
abortion.quote: I believe that life for everyone begins at conception, and we must do everything we can to protect those unborn.

energy.text: Smith supported rescinding the Clean Power Plan, saying it would lower electricity prices and keep coal plants and jobs in Missouri.
energy.quote: Rescinding the Clean Power Plan stops the Obama Administration’s costly rules for energy production, lowers the price of electricity, and keeps coal plants and jobs in Missouri.

voting.text: Smith supported photo ID at polling places and opposed legislation he said would block state voter ID laws.
voting.quote: Simple protections like witness signatures on absentee ballots, official postmarks, photo ID at your polling place and in-person voting by all who are able are all commonsense concepts to ensure that every legal vote counts.

wages.text: He says he will back the PRO Act to strengthen worker rights and unions and secure better pay and safer conditions.
wages.quote: Back pro-labor bills like the PRO Act to protect lower- and middle-class families by strengthening worker rights against employers, banning union-busting tactics, and ensuring fair bargaining for better pay and safer conditions.
